name: @clipform/mcp-server

tools.name: clipform_create_form

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in (id from clipform_whoami workspaces). Omit to use the connection's default workspace.

prompt.description: The text shown to the respondent

label.description: Short label for the node (used in logic builder). Defaults to the prompt text.

config.description: Type-specific configuration keyed by node type. Omit to use defaults. Per-type keys, shapes, and defaults are listed in the clipform_create_form description; craft guidance via clipform_get_guide.

options.description: Answer options. choice: required, min 1, max 6, content max 36 chars button: required, min 1, max 1, content max 28 chars

is_correct.description: Mark this as the correct answer for a quiz (maps to score 1; other options score 0). Use this OR score, not both.

score.description: Score value for this option (for scored quizzes). Use 1 for correct, 0 for wrong. Scored options automatically enable correct-answer marking (record_scores) and correct/incorrect answer feedback on the node; set config.choice.show_answer_feedback: false to hide the feedback.

nodes.description: Ordered list of nodes/steps for the form

show_step_counter.description: Show step counter (e.g. '1/5'). Set true for quizzes.

disable_back_navigation.description: Prevent going back. Set true for quizzes.

primary_color.description: Primary/brand color as 6-digit hex (e.g. '#FF5500'). Used for buttons and accents.

font_family.description: AI-PROTECTED: Only set when the user explicitly requests a specific font.

tags.description: Tags for indexing (e.g. ['quiz', 'trivia', 'arsenal']). Include format, genre, and topics.

tools.name: clipform_import_form
tools.description: Copies the questions from a public Google Form, Typeform, or Tally form into a new Clipform draft. The source form and its responses stay where they are. Supported URLs: Google Forms (docs.google.com or forms.gle - must be shared as "Anyone with the link"), Typeform (form.typeform.com/to/...), and Tally (tally.so - must be public). The source form must be publicly accessible; a private form's questions cannot be read. The new Clipform is created as a DRAFT - review it, then republish with clipform_update_form (is_live: true) once it's ready. Some question types don't map cleanly to a Clipform node and are skipped rather than guessed at; the result always reports exactly what was imported vs skipped, and why.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in (id from clipform_whoami workspaces). Omit to use the connection's default workspace.

url.description: Public URL of the Google Form, Typeform, or Tally form to import

tools.name: clipform_list_forms
tools.description: List forms in your workspace with optional filtering. Returns paginated results (cursor-based). next_cursor is included when more results exist. To find or open a form by name, pass search with part of its title instead of paging through results. Needs a signed-in Clipform account (an anonymous session is asked to sign in).

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in (id from clipform_whoami workspaces). Omit to use the connection's default workspace.

limit.description: Number of forms to return (default 25, max 100)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from previous response's next_cursor

tag.description: Filter by tag name(s), comma-separated. AND logic: only forms with ALL tags are returned.

search.description: Filter to forms whose title contains this text (case-insensitive substring). Use this to resolve a form by name in one call instead of paginating.

tools.name: clipform_whoami
tools.description: Show the current identity: auth mode (api key, oauth, session, or anonymous), active workspace, and plan limits. Needs a signed-in Clipform account (an anonymous session is asked to sign in).

tools.name: clipform_get_form
tools.description: Retrieve a form's details including all nodes in sequential order and their routing. Returns title, settings, and every node with its options, config, media status, and next node (from clipform_set_logic).

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

tools.name: clipform_update_form
tools.description: Update a form's title, publish status, settings, or tags. Only sends fields that are provided - omitted fields remain unchanged. AI-PROTECTED parameters have restrictions noted in their descriptions.

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

is_live.description: Setting true publishes/republishes the snapshot respondents see. Forms are live from creation, but edits and media attached AFTER creation are not visible until you re-send true - republishing is the expected final step of a build, never skip it after attaching media. Setting false takes the form offline (keeps the last published snapshot) - AI-PROTECTED: only take a form offline when the user explicitly asks.

show_step_counter.description: Show step counter (e.g. '1/5'). Recommended for quizzes.

disable_back_navigation.description: Prevent respondents from going back. Recommended for quizzes.

total_steps.description: Override the total step count shown in the step counter. Set null to auto-calculate.

primary_color.description: Primary/brand color as 6-digit hex (e.g. '#FF5500'). Used for buttons and accents.

font_family.description: AI-PROTECTED: Only set when the user explicitly requests a specific font.

description.description: SEO description (meta description, og:description). Set null to clear.

author.description: AI-PROTECTED: Only set when the user explicitly provides an author name. Set null to clear.

logo_url.description: AI-PROTECTED: Only set when the user explicitly provides a logo URL. Set null to clear.

show_branding.description: Show Clipform branding. Set false to remove (Pro plan).

brand_name.description: AI-PROTECTED: Custom brand name shown in footer. Only set when user explicitly provides.

cover_media_asset_id.description: Cover image: the picture shown in emails, link previews and on the embed button, cropped to the form's 9:16 frame. A media_asset_id of a ready still image in this form's workspace. Set null to clear and fall back to the first step's media. Goes live on the next publish (is_live: true), which can be in the same call.

tags.description: Replace all tags on this form. Pass the full desired set (e.g. ['quiz', 'trivia', 'slug:elephants']). Omit to leave tags unchanged.

tools.name: clipform_delete_form
tools.description: Move a form and all its nodes to the trash. It stops accepting responses immediately and can be restored later. Requires user confirmation before it runs. Needs a signed-in Clipform account (an anonymous session is asked to sign in).

form_id.description: The form UUID to delete (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after the user has explicitly confirmed this destructive action. Leave unset otherwise - hosts that support confirmation dialogs will prompt the user automatically.

tools.name: clipform_get_results
tools.description: View response counts, choice/action answer breakdowns, and recent open-text answers for a form. Contact, file, draw, camera, and payment answers are counts only - use the dashboard for per-response detail. Needs a signed-in Clipform account (an anonymous session is asked to sign in).

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

tools.name: clipform_get_responses
tools.description: List a Clipform form's individual responses (submissions) with time filtering - complements clipform_get_results (aggregates). Answers questions like 'what came in during the last 24 hours', 'what's the longest answer', 'what did people say'. Text answers plus a non-PII payment summary (amount and status); contact details, file uploads, and audio/video answers are redacted to placeholders and the customer's payment details stay in the dashboard (the responses URL from clipform_get_form). Responses are sorted newest first unless sort: 'oldest'. Needs a signed-in Clipform account (an anonymous session is asked to sign in).

since.description: Only responses submitted at or after this ISO 8601 time (e.g. '2026-08-29T00:00:00Z')

until.description: Only responses submitted at or before this ISO 8601 time

query.description: Only responses whose text answers contain this string (case-insensitive)

sort.description: Order by submission time. Default: newest

tools.name: clipform_add_node
tools.description: Add a new node to an existing form. Inserted before the end screen by default; after_node_id controls insertion position. Inserting into a linear flow automatically re-links the chain (the node before the insertion point points to the new node, which points to what followed) - you do not need clipform_set_logic for a simple insert. Branching still needs an explicit logic write. Node types and config schemas match clipform_create_form.

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

prompt.description: The text shown to the respondent

label.description: Short label for the node (used in logic builder). Defaults to the prompt text.

config.description: Type-specific configuration keyed by node type. Omit to use defaults. Per-type keys, shapes, and defaults are listed in the clipform_create_form description; craft guidance via clipform_get_guide.

options.description: Answer options. choice: required, min 1, max 6, content max 36 chars button: required, min 1, max 1, content max 28 chars

is_correct.description: Mark this as the correct answer for a quiz (maps to score 1; other options score 0). Use this OR score, not both.

score.description: Score value for this option (for scored quizzes). Use 1 for correct, 0 for wrong. Scored options automatically enable correct-answer marking (record_scores) and correct/incorrect answer feedback on the node; set config.choice.show_answer_feedback: false to hide the feedback.

after_node_id.description: Insert after this node ID. Omit to append before the end screen.

tools.name: clipform_update_node
tools.description: Update one or more existing nodes' text, type, config, or options. Pass multiple updates in one call instead of separate tool calls. Requires node IDs (returned by clipform_create_form, clipform_add_node, or clipform_get_form). Does not change node positions in the flow. All type definitions and config schemas are derived from @vid-master/config (node-types).

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

label.description: Short label for the node (used in logic builder)

config.description: Type-specific configuration keyed by node type. Omit to use defaults. Per-type keys, shapes, and defaults are listed in the clipform_create_form description; craft guidance via clipform_get_guide. Merged shallowly into the stored config - only the keys you pass are changed. Set a key to null to delete it; nested objects are replaced wholesale. When type is changed in the same call, config replaces the stored configuration instead of merging.

options.description: Replace all options (for choice nodes). Omit to keep existing options.

is_correct.description: Mark this as the correct answer for a quiz (maps to score 1; other options score 0). Use this OR score, not both.

score.description: Score value for this option (for scored quizzes). Use 1 for correct, 0 for wrong. Scored options automatically enable correct-answer marking (record_scores) and correct/incorrect answer feedback on the node; set config.choice.show_answer_feedback: false to hide the feedback.

updates.description: One or more node updates to apply

tools.name: clipform_delete_node
tools.description: Delete a node from a form. The logic chain is automatically re-linked (the previous node will point to the next one). Cannot delete the start node or the last end screen. On a live form the node stays on the live form until the form is published. Requires user confirmation before it runs.

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after the user has explicitly confirmed this destructive action. Leave unset otherwise - hosts that support confirmation dialogs will prompt the user automatically.

tools.name: clipform_upload_media_asset
tools.description:
Put one or more media files into your workspace media library (max 10, uploaded sequentially). This is step one of attaching media to a node - follow up with clipform_attach_node_media to place the returned media_asset_id on a node.

When a public URL is provided, the media is fetched and stored automatically. The API picks where each asset is stored based on its size and type. Word-level captions from clipform_generate_tts enable per-word highlighting in the viewer once attached - pass the caption_ref it returned instead of hand-copying the captions array.

PDFs (media_type document) are for consent agreements: they return a document descriptor, not a media_asset_id.

Provide media via `items` (explicit type + URL), `files` (files attached by the host client), or both. At least one is required.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in (id from clipform_whoami workspaces). Omit to use the connection's default workspace.

form_id.description: The form this is for (from clipform_create_form) - a routing hint only, to pick the right workspace. The result still lands in the workspace library, not on a node. Required on an anonymous session, or this lands in a different workspace and clipform_attach_node_media will not find it.

items.description: One or more media items to create as workspace library assets

media_type.description: Type of media. Use document for a consent-agreement PDF (url required, PDF only).

filename.description: Display filename for a document (media_type document). Defaults to the URL's file name.

url.description: Public URL that links directly to the media file itself. When provided, the server fetches and stores it directly.

captions.description: Word-level captions from clipform_generate_tts. `words` is a required field on each caption (schema-enforced) - pass the full objects returned by clipform_generate_tts unmodified.

words.description: Per-word timestamps within the segment. Required - copy the full array from clipform_generate_tts verbatim.

caption_ref.description: caption_ref from clipform_generate_tts - an opaque handle that attaches that TTS run's word-level captions to this asset, resolved server-side. Preferred over captions.

ai_generated.description: Whether this media was AI-generated. Drives the viewer's disclosure chip - set true for AI-rendered/synthesized media.

files.description: Files attached by the host client. Each becomes a video or still library asset (or a consent-agreement document for application/pdf) based on its declared mime_type.

download_url.description: Short-lived URL the server downloads the file's bytes from

file_id.description: Host-assigned identifier for the attached file

mime_type.description: Declared MIME type - determines whether the file becomes a video or still asset

tools.name: clipform_complete_media_upload
tools.description: Confirm a signed-PUT still image upload finished, after PUTting the bytes to the upload_url returned by clipform_upload_media_asset. The API verifies the object actually landed in storage before flipping the asset from processing to ready - call this right after the PUT succeeds, or the asset stays invisible in the library. Not needed for video uploads (they settle automatically).

media_asset_id.description: The media_asset_id returned by clipform_upload_media_asset for the still image

form_id.description: The form this is for (from clipform_create_form) - a routing hint only, to pick the right workspace. The result still lands in the workspace library, not on a node. Required on an anonymous session, or this lands in a different workspace and clipform_attach_node_media will not find it.

tools.name: clipform_attach_node_media
tools.description: Attach an existing workspace media asset (from clipform_upload_media_asset) to one or more nodes (max 10). Pass one item or many; multiple items attach sequentially. Only works on node types that support media (choice, open, scale, draw, binary, button). A media asset is reusable - attach the same media_asset_id to several nodes.

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

media_asset_id.description: A media asset ID returned by clipform_upload_media_asset

fit_media.description: Show the whole frame (contain) instead of cover-cropping. ALWAYS set true when attaching renders from clipform_render_composition or clipform_render_video_template - they are composed 9:16 frames that must never be cropped. Leave unset for user-supplied media (arbitrary aspect ratios want the cover default).

show_captions.description: Display captions/subtitles on the node. Defaults to on; pass false to hide them.

items.description: One or more attachments to make

tools.name: clipform_get_node_media
tools.description: Get the media attached to a node, including processing status. Useful for checking if a video upload has finished processing.

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

tools.name: clipform_delete_node_media
tools.description: Remove media from a node by unlinking it; the media asset and its files stay in the workspace library and keep working on any other node or live form that uses them. Requires user confirmation before it runs.

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after the user has explicitly confirmed this destructive action. Leave unset otherwise - hosts that support confirmation dialogs will prompt the user automatically.

tools.name: clipform_set_logic
tools.description:
Set the next node for one or more nodes, wiring a linear route (A to B to C). Pass multiple nodes in one call instead of separate tool calls. Each node routes to exactly one target node. Branching by which option a respondent picks is not configured here; it is set up in the form's Build tab in the dashboard (the builder URL returned by clipform_get_form / clipform_create_form).

A call replaces that node's routing entirely - it does not merge with any prior target.

Example:
  nodes: [
    { node_id: "q1-id", rules: [{ target_node_id: "q2-id" }] },
    { node_id: "q2-id", rules: [{ target_node_id: "q3-id" }] }
  ]

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

node_id.description: The node ID to set routing on

target_node_id.description: The node ID this node routes to

rules.description: Exactly one rule: the single node this node routes to

nodes.description: One or more nodes to set logic on

tools.name: clipform_log_generation
tools.description: Internal audit step run by a form-generation workflow. Records a completed generation's content provenance (sources, image attributions) for the flow that just built the form. Not a user action - only call it as the final step of a generation workflow you are running, never in response to a plain create or edit request.

form_id.description: The form ID (UUID format, not the share ID)

summary.description: Short description of what was generated

tools.name: clipform_search_news
tools.description:
Search recent news articles from NewsAPI and The Guardian and return them as structured results.

Coverage: recent events, people, and topics (post-May-2025). Does NOT cover timeless topics (history, geography, science).

Returns: article title, source, author, date, URL, description, and image URL per result.

query.description: News search query (e.g. 'Iran war 2026', 'Australian Open final', 'UK election')

tools.name: clipform_generate_tts
tools.description:
Generate narration audio from text with word-level captions. Use this for quiz question narration, survey introductions, form instructions, or any node that benefits from a human voice. Proactively suggest narration for quizzes and content-rich forms - it significantly improves engagement.

Available voices: ryan (British male, clear), sonia (British female, warm), andrew (American male, smooth), ava (American female, vibrant), guy (American male, deep). Pick ONE voice that fits the topic - e.g. a London quiz gets ryan or sonia, a US sports quiz gets andrew or guy - and reuse that SAME voice for every item and every call across the whole form. Never mix voices within one form unless the user explicitly asks for multiple voices.

Use the tone parameter to direct HOW the voice speaks. Always set a tone that matches the form's mood - e.g. quizzes: "Energetic and playful, like a quiz show host teasing the audience", surveys: "Professional but warm, encouraging honest answers", personality quizzes: "Curious and reflective". This dramatically improves the narration quality.

Pass one item or many (max 10) - multiple items run in parallel. Returns audio_url and caption_ref per item - pass caption_ref downstream to clipform_render_composition / clipform_render_video_template / clipform_upload_media_asset to attach this run's word-level captions instead of hand-copying the captions array.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in (id from clipform_whoami workspaces). Omit to use the connection's default workspace.

form_id.description: The form this is for (from clipform_create_form) - a routing hint only, to pick the right workspace. The result still lands in the workspace library, not on a node. Required on an anonymous session, or this lands in a different workspace and clipform_attach_node_media will not find it.

voice.description: Voice: ryan (British male, clear/articulate), sonia (British female, warm/bright), andrew (American male, smooth/neutral), ava (American female, vibrant/friendly), guy (American male, deep/authoritative). Pick ONE voice for the whole form based on its topic and audience, then reuse that same voice on every item and every call - never mix voices within a form unless the user explicitly asks for more than one.

tone.description: Style instructions for how the voice should sound. E.g. 'Speak like an energetic quiz show host, playful and teasing' or 'Warm and conversational, like chatting with a friend'. Infer from context if not specified by the user.

items.description: One or more TTS items to generate

tools.name: clipform_search_media
tools.description:
Search images or stock video clips. Pass one query or many (max 10) - multiple queries run in one call instead of separate tool calls. Use results to feed into clipform_render_video_template (slideshow) for narrated slideshow videos, or upload directly as still images via clipform_upload_media_asset then clipform_attach_node_media. All results are pre-cleared for commercial use. Results include a description (alt text where the provider has it) - use it to pick visually distinct images.

Example: { queries: [{ query: "saturn rings" }, { query: "mars surface", count: 3 }] } returns portrait images for both.

query.description: What to search for (e.g. 'african lion', 'saturn rings')

kind.description: image = stock photos (default), video = stock clips

count.description: Max results per provider (default 6 for image, 3 for video)

orientation.description: portrait (default) fills the 9:16 frame; landscape gets auto blur-pad framing in Ken Burns videos

queries.description: One or more search queries to run

tools.name: clipform_render_composition
tools.description:
Render a specialised video composition to MP4 or PNG - custom animated visuals that a video template can't provide, such as geography animations or designed motion graphics. Available composition names and their required input props schemas come from clipform_list_compositions.

Output formats: mp4 (H.264, best for social media) or png (single frame). Returns a public URL when complete.

For multi-render builds (e.g. one clip per quiz question), pass everything in ONE call via items (max 10): all renders fire in parallel and you get one job ID each - then collect the URLs in a single clipform_check_render call with job_ids. Single render: pass compositionId/inputProps at the top level (wait: true blocks and returns the URL; wait: false returns a job ID).

Choosing a render tool: for a recognisable form/quiz beat (guess-the-city, this-or-that, mystery reveal, multiple choice, photo montage...) reach for a video template first (clipform_list_video_templates + clipform_render_video_template) - it is a one-call recipe. For a photo/clip montage, narrated or silent, use the slideshow template (pass audio_url to sync it to a voice track). Use clipform_render_composition only when neither fits and you need a custom layer stack.
A render for a form node is not done until it is attached to that node. Pass node_id (and form_id) so the completed render attaches itself automatically - do not poll clipform_check_render to completion or manually chain clipform_upload_media_asset + clipform_attach_node_media; fire the render and move on. In batch mode, set node_id per item (see items) and form_id once at the top level.

compositionId.description: Single render: the composition ID. Call clipform_list_compositions to see available options (e.g. 'Slideshow', 'Map', 'Grid', 'Timeline', 'Silhouette', 'Text', 'Rebus', 'Scene', 'ShortFormQuiz', 'ScorecardQuiz', 'ScorecardGK', 'CountrySilhouetteQuiz'). Use items instead for multiple renders.

inputProps.description: Single render: props object matching the composition's schema from clipform_list_compositions. Validated STRICTLY - unknown or missing props fail with the schema in the error, nothing renders silently with defaults. For map compositions (Map), wide shots (camera.zoom < 9) may round lat/lng to 1 decimal place to improve cache hit rates; close shots and pin drops should keep full precision — the pin lands exactly on `target`.

wait.description: Single render only: true (default) blocks until the render is ready and returns its URL; false returns a job ID for clipform_check_render. Batch items always run fire-and-poll.

items.description: Batch mode: multiple renders in one call. All fire in parallel; returns one job ID per item - collect with clipform_check_render (job_ids). Use this whenever rendering more than one clip.

inputProps.description: Props matching the composition's schema - validated strictly

node_id.description: Form node to attach this item's render to automatically once it completes. Requires the batch's top-level form_id.

captions.description: Word-level captions from clipform_generate_tts - carried onto the attached media asset. Only used when node_id is set.

words.description: Per-word timestamps within the segment. Required - copy the full array from clipform_generate_tts verbatim.

caption_ref.description: caption_ref from clipform_generate_tts - an opaque handle that attaches that TTS run's word-level captions to the media asset, resolved server-side. Preferred over captions. Only used when node_id is set.

node_id.description: Single render only: form node to attach this render to automatically once it completes. Requires form_id. For batch mode, set node_id per item instead.

form_id.description: The form UUID - required when node_id is set (single render) or any item sets node_id (batch).

captions.description: Single render only: word-level captions from clipform_generate_tts, carried onto the attached media asset. Only used when node_id is set. For batch mode, set captions per item instead.

words.description: Per-word timestamps within the segment. Required - copy the full array from clipform_generate_tts verbatim.

caption_ref.description: Single render only: caption_ref from clipform_generate_tts - an opaque handle that attaches that TTS run's word-level captions to the media asset, resolved server-side. Preferred over captions. Only used when node_id is set. For batch mode, set caption_ref per item instead.

tools.name: clipform_search_music
tools.description: Search for royalty-free music tracks and ambient sounds. Quiz forms especially benefit from background music - it keeps energy up between questions. Also consider it for multi-step surveys and longer forms. Pass the returned URL as the audio for the slideshow video template via clipform_render_video_template. Returns download URLs, duration, artist, and license info.

query.description: What to search for (e.g. 'upbeat quiz background', 'calm ambient', 'playful pizzicato')

tags.description: Genre/mood tags to filter by. Multiple tags are ANDed together (e.g. ['ambient', 'chill'] matches tracks tagged both).

tools.name: clipform_list_compositions
tools.description: Browse available video compositions and their expected props schemas. Call this before using clipform_render_composition to discover visual styles and their input props. For an image or photo montage, reach for a video template (clipform_list_video_templates + clipform_render_video_template) instead of a composition.

tools.name: clipform_list_video_templates
tools.description: Browse available video templates - curated Scene arrangements (bed + overlay + sane defaults) that render through the Scene composition from a small controls object. Call this before clipform_render_video_template to see template names and their exposed controls. For a fully custom layer stack, assemble Scene layers directly via clipform_render_composition instead.

tools.name: clipform_render_video_template
tools.description:
Render a curated video template (a pre-arranged Scene: bed + overlay + sane defaults) to MP4 or PNG from a small controls object, instead of hand-assembling Scene layers. Call clipform_list_video_templates first for available template names and their controls. Renders through the Scene composition under the hood.

Choosing a render tool: for a recognisable form/quiz beat (guess-the-city, this-or-that, mystery reveal, multiple choice, photo montage...) reach for a video template first (clipform_list_video_templates + clipform_render_video_template) - it is a one-call recipe. For a photo/clip montage, narrated or silent, use the slideshow template (pass audio_url to sync it to a voice track). Use clipform_render_composition only when neither fits and you need a custom layer stack.
A render for a form node is not done until it is attached to that node. Pass node_id (and form_id) so the completed render attaches itself automatically - do not poll clipform_check_render to completion or manually chain clipform_upload_media_asset + clipform_attach_node_media; fire the render and move on.

controls.description: Template-specific controls (see clipform_list_video_templates for the exposed control surface).

wait.description: true (default) blocks until the render is ready and returns its URL; false returns a job ID for clipform_check_render.

node_id.description: Form node to attach this render to automatically once it completes - skips the manual clipform_upload_media_asset + clipform_attach_node_media steps and republishes the form if it's currently live. Requires form_id.

form_id.description: The form UUID (required when node_id is set).

captions.description: Word-level captions from clipform_generate_tts - carried onto the attached media asset. Only used when node_id is set.

words.description: Per-word timestamps within the segment. Required - copy the full array from clipform_generate_tts verbatim.

caption_ref.description: caption_ref from clipform_generate_tts - an opaque handle that attaches that TTS run's word-level captions to the media asset, resolved server-side. Preferred over captions. instructions: Clipform builds interactive video-style forms that other people fill in, with their answers (video, audio, or text) stored for the owner to read back: quiz, survey, interview, testimonial, application, booking, client intake, and lead capture. Drafting questions as text to review or paste is a chat task, not a Clipform build. When this is the start of a new conversation and the user has not yet said what they want to build, welcome them as someone who is now connected to Clipform and offer to build their first form together, then offer these starting points as plain text: quiz, survey, interview, testimonial, application, booking, client intake, lead capture, or something else - ask which one fits, or invite them to describe what they need instead. If the user's first message already states what they want to build, even loosely, skip that offer entirely and go straight into the brief-driven flow below. When the brief is clear, build the form directly; when it's vague, ask one or two short questions first. Prefer rich media: video over images over plain text. Before building, derive a register from the topic and audience (e.g. hype, playful, warm, considered, elegant, sombre); if the user states a mood explicitly, that wins. State the register once, then apply it to every rendering choice - narration tone, motion preset, music, pacing. Never mix registers in one form. At the start of a build, call clipform_get_workflow to load the recipe for the form type, and clipform_get_guide for craft detail. Every *_id argument is a UUID returned by the tools - not the short share_id from a form URL. Use clipform_whoami when the request is about the account itself (the active workspace, plan, or limits); building a form does not need it first. Deleting a form moves it to the trash (restorable from the dashboard); deleting a node cannot be undone (a node deleted on a live form stays on the live form until you publish); removing media from a node only unlinks it, and the media asset stays in the library. Those tools ask the user to confirm before running.
